assumptions: Git commit objects and local Git plumbing provide stable fixed patches; the named tracked-tree observation describes only the declared finite replay domain.
compatibility: Existing AIM, analysis-report, Git request/provenance and 0.2.0-draft certificate contracts remain unchanged. New Git replay evidence and plan contracts are 0.1.0-alpha.
domain: Local SHA-1 Git repositories with one base commit and 2–4 descendant commit sources, at most 64 changed paths and 1 MiB aggregate patch bytes.
execution_contract: No checkout or source mutation. Replay fixed patches in a temporary bare repository and fresh temporary Git index, using local file transport only. No project commands, agents, network services, or external effects. Every plan has executionAuthorization false.
hypotheses: Bounded replay of all admissible orders may identify fixed-patch tracked-tree equivalence cases that support useful advisory preparation waves without authorizing execution.
observation_contract: tracked-tree-v1: final Git tree object for each complete schedule, with per-step tree IDs, patch digests, schedule status and reasons retained in evidence.
